question: show me status of resin
sql:
SELECT v.item_code, v.item_name, v.rank, v.branch_ranks, v.available_qty, v.stock_qty, v.hold_qty, v.issued_qty_3m, v.issue_lines_3m, v.last_issued_on, v.issued_since, v.data_through, v.daily_burn, v.days_of_cover, v.open_demand_qty, v.open_requisitions, v.earliest_required_date, v.demand_statuses, v.demand_purchased_qty, v.demand_overdue, v.incoming_qty, v.incoming_consignments, v.earliest_eta, v.incoming_statuses, v.suggested_buy_qty
FROM v_item_demand_picture v
WHERE v.item_name ~* '[[:<:]]resins?[[:>:]]'

question: Highest consumption
sql:
WITH resin_consumption AS (
    SELECT v.item_code,
           i.name AS item_name,
           i.default_unit_of_measurement AS uom,
           SUM(v.quantity) AS consumption_quantity
    FROM v_item_consumption_monthly v
    JOIN items i ON i.item_code = v.item_code
    WHERE i.name ~* '[[:<:]]resins?[[:>:]]'
      AND v.period >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date
      AND v.period < (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month')::date
    GROUP BY v.item_code, i.name, i.default_unit_of_measurement
)
SELECT rc.item_code,
       rc.item_name,
       rc.uom,
       rc.consumption_quantity,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.consumption_quantity) AS tie_count
FROM resin_consumption rc
ORDER BY rc.consumption_quantity DESC, rc.item_code
